verdict.rationale: Pulumi's testing guide describes three test types. Unit tests run in memory and mock all external calls, so they never touch real infrastructure. Property tests assert on resources during deployment, and integration tests deploy ephemeral infrastructure and test against it. Unit tests are written in the program's own language with standard frameworks such as Mocha or NUnit, and `pulumi preview` adds a no-change dry run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the mocked unit-testing and ephemeral integration-testing workflows work as documented.
